This office received a letter on October 30, 2000, from Faye A. Flowers, attorney for the
Petitioner in this matter, stating that the Petitioner is withdrawing its appeal of the South
Carolina Department of Transportation’s June 5, 2000, Notice of Denial of DBE Certification in
connection of the above-referenced docket number. Therefore, finding good cause,
IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that the above-captioned case be dismissed.
AND IT IS SO ORDERED.
